translation_notes: `not any(g.triples((s, p, o)))` becomes `not bool(m{ {s} p o })`, and the guarded `.add(...)` becomes `+{ }` on the @graph-designated self.service_description.

self and sd_subj are unannotated method context (self.service_description, a local bound earlier in prepare_sd_graph); rdflib_endpoint is not installed here either. added an identical `service_description = self.service_description` line to both original.py and translated.ldpy so the pilot's module-state comparison has a graph to compare (self is not a module-level Graph).

validation.method: module-state per scenario (separate shim per side)

repair.driver: Hand-written driver replacing the generic run_pair: drops `shim` from sys.modules before each side so each side gets its own self.service_description (asserted distinct), and runs five scenarios per side: empty graph; the three neighbours sharing two terms with the guarded triple (sd_subj sd:resultFormat formats:Turtle, sd_subj sd:feature formats:RDF_XML, ex:other sd:resultFormat formats:RDF_XML); triple already present; sd_subj a fresh BNode (the repository's `next(...) or BNode()`, sparql_router.py:418) with another blank node carrying the triple; and BNode already carrying it. Also checks on the original that each scenario adds the expected 1 or 0 triples.
repair.remaining: The guard replaced by `if True` stays green, and must: g.add of a triple already present is a no-op, so the guard has no observable effect on the graph; this is equivalence, not a weak oracle.

optimization_notes: Python: the triple written twice is bound once to `triple`, and `not any(g.triples(triple))` becomes `triple not in g` (Graph.__contains__ is that same search). The guard itself stays although `add` of a present triple is a no-op on the plain Graph the repository uses: on a ConjunctiveGraph or Dataset receiver `triples()` spans every context while `add` writes the default one, so dropping it would change the effect there.

LD Python: `if not bool(m{ … }):` loses the redundant `bool()`; otherwise the translation (`@graph` + `m{ }` guard + `+{ }`) was minimal. The Python-shaped variant with prefixed names (`triple = (sd_subj, sd:resultFormat, formats:RDF_XML)` …) measures 7 tokens longer, so the islands stay. No exception to the symmetry rule. The `service_description = …` line is the pilot's harness, copied as is.
